Operator: Good afternoon, and welcome to the NVIDIA Corporation fourth quarter earnings conference call.
Jensen Huang: Thanks, everyone, for joining us today.
Turning to guidance: our full-year outlook remains unchanged from last quarter, and demand for Blackwell continues to outstrip supply across every major cloud partner.
Colette Kress: Turning now to the financial results, revenue for the quarter grew significantly compared to the prior year period.
